title: Tinkerbell
description: Tinkerbell app health: alerts, log-error volume, LLM provider errors, proxy errors, process health, workflows, cost/usage.

panels.title: App Log Health (all warn/error/fatal, backs TinkerbellAppErrorVolumeElevated)

panels.description: Any warn-level log line from the tinkerbell app, any type.
panels.title: Warn logs (24h)

panels.description: error/fatal log lines from the tinkerbell app, any failure type. Same series TinkerbellAppErrorVolumeElevated alerts on (>3/hour sustained 10m).
panels.title: Error/fatal logs (24h)

panels.description: All warn+error+fatal combined, last hour, mirrors the alert's own increase() window.
panels.title: Total problem logs (1h, alert window)

panels.description: Credit-balance / billing failures from LLM providers. Bucketed via HTTP 402 OR message body matching 'credit balance'/'insufficient'/'out of credits' etc. (Anthropic returns 400 with invalid_request_error for this). Highest priority — chat is silently failing.
panels.title: Payment errors (24h)

panels.description: Node event loop responsiveness. Sustained values above ~50ms suggest CPU-bound work or GC pressure.

panels.description: Time spent in garbage collection. Spikes correlate with event-loop lag.
panels.title: GC duration

panels.description: Sum of user-facing cost across all purposes (USD). DB UsageRecord is canonical.

panels.description: Shows when each provider last succeeded and last had a payment error. The LLMProviderPaymentRequired alert stays firing as long as the payment error timestamp is more recent than the success timestamp. A 0 means 'never observed since pod start.'
